description: This file defines a helper class for logging, providing static methods and constants to facilitate log message printing and chaining of log nodes in an Android environment.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static logging methods and constants to facilitate logging within an Android environment, supporting chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert (wtf) message, with optional throwable.
